upload.label: Add images
upload.instruction: Add images to the queue (drag and drop or use the button) to get started.

settings.label: Set parameters
settings.instruction: Set the target size and format. PNG is lossless, so the quality slider is disabled for it.

review.label: Review list and prefixes
review.instruction: Check the previews and file statuses. If needed, click "Fix crop" and save a manual crop. You can also give all files a name prefix (numbered automatically). When everything looks right, click "Approve".

process.label: Process
process.instruction: In this step you start processing.

download.label: Download and start over
download.instruction: After processing, download files one by one or as a ZIP. Hover over a step to see its description, and use the "Clear files" button to start over.

next.cropping: Fix the crop of the selected image and click "Save".
next.empty: Add images in the "Add images" step.
next.processing: Processing in progress. Wait for it to finish and check the statuses in the file list.
next.hasErrors: Some files have errors. Fix the crop in the list and run processing again.
next.done: All done. Download files one by one or the whole ZIP package.
next.ready: Check the settings and click "Start processing".

upload.title: Step 1. Add images
upload.description: Drag files here or choose them with the button. Supported formats: JPG, PNG, WebP. Limit: {maxFiles} files, up to {maxSizeMb} MB each.

settings.title: Step 2. Set parameters
settings.description: The default is 800×600. Change it only if you need a different final size.

queue.title: Step 3. File list and status
queue.description: After processing you can download a file right away or fix the crop manually and run processing again.
queue.emptyFiltered: No files with the selected status.
queue.acceptState: Approve the current state and continue

processing.title: Step 4. Process
processing.description: In this step you start processing. The ZIP download becomes available in step 5 once processing has finished.

download.title: Step 5. Download
download.description: Download single images with the "Download" button in step 3. Here you can download the whole set as a ZIP.

crop.title: Manual crop
crop.description: Drag the selected rectangle to set the crop. The aspect ratio is locked to the final size.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.filesAdded: Added {count} file to the queue. | Added {count} files to the queue.
notifications.prefixApplied: Applied a new name prefix to {count} file. | Applied a new name prefix to {count} files.
notifications.cropSaved: Saved a manual crop for {name}. Run processing again.
notifications.noFiles: Add at least one image first.
notifications.processedWithErrors: Processing finished with errors. Check the list and fix the crops.
notifications.processed: Processing finished. You can download files one by one or as a ZIP.
notifications.settingsChanged: Settings have changed since the last run. Run processing again before downloading.
notifications.notReady: This file is not ready for download yet.

validation.tooManyFiles: The limit of {max} files per session has been exceeded.
validation.unsupportedFormat: Unsupported format. Add JPG, PNG or WebP.
validation.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than {maxSizeMb} MB.

errors.imageEncode: Could not generate the output image.
errors.canvasUnsupported: This browser does not support Canvas 2D.
